channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about John Collins | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about John Collins from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Trae Young on John Collins
item.description:
Trae Young on John Collins being traded to Utah:

“It's definitely tough seeing him go but at the same time like you know this is the business. JC knows that too like we've had conversations over the years and we're so close that we noticed in the business if we don't win things can change in a heartbeat. Me as a teammate I loved playing with JC I've throwing a lot of lobs to him he's made me look really good a lot. I've always appreciated JC and I wish him nothing but the best.”

Trae Young on John Collins, Jul 14, 2023. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Joe Prunty on John Collins
item.description:
Prunty, on John Collins:

“He is out tonight, but we are continuing through the protocol process.”

Joe Prunty on John Collins, Feb 24, 2023. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Nate McMillan on John Collins
item.description:
Nate McMillan on John Collins:

“John is capable of scoring, not just inside but outside. I think he is a good 3-point shooter. We can spread the floor with him, and I would like him to take more attempts.”

Nate McMillan on John Collins, Nov 22, 2022. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Clint Capela, John Collins
item.description:
Antetokounmpo said of Okongwu.

“Capela is another one. Collins, another one. But I always love playing against people that take pride in defending and take the challenge. You can kind of feel that. I have played against people that you kind of know that they’re not taking this too serious and they kind of have that fear factor in their mind and you can kind of see it in their eyes, kind of smell it from the first play.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Clint Capela, John Collins, Nov 9, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Trae Young on John Collins
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:Trae Young on John Collins:

“Of course, we all know we need John, to go as far as we want to go. But at this point in the season, we have to have that next-man-up mentality... Especially with the numbers he produces, we have to all kind of contribute a little bit more.”

Trae Young on John Collins, Feb 28, 2022. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Nate McMillan on John Collins
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:Nate McMillan on John Collins:

“He's been active. He's doing a good job of getting out & running again. We didn't really see that early in the season. John is one of the fastest bigs in the league, and his ability to run and put pressure on that defense really causes problems.”

Nate McMillan on John Collins, Jan 30, 2022. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Nate McMillan on John Collins
item.description:
McMillan on Collins/ankle:

“John is doing better but he's just not ready to play tonight.”

Nate McMillan on John Collins, Apr 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Travis Schlenk on John Collins
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:Hawks GM Travis Schlenk on John Collins:

“We never had any serious conversations, with any team, about moving him this year.”

Travis Schlenk on John Collins, Mar 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Trae Young on John Collins
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:Trae Young on John Collins:

“He's unbelievable. He's been playing great. They're going to continue to send two & leave him open & he's going to continue to knock 'em down & make the right play... We're going to need it from him.”

Trae Young on John Collins, Mar 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Steve Clifford on John Collins, Lloyd Pierce
item.description:
Steve Clifford on the firing of Lloyd Pierce:

“It sucks. Plus he's done a really good job... He started from scratch there and he's done a really good job. Last year, in my opinion, if John Collins doesn't miss all those games, they're a playoff team.”

Steve Clifford on John Collins, Lloyd Pierce, Mar 1, 2021. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Antony Ressler on Travis Schlenk, John Collins
item.description:
Hawks owner Tony Ressler said.

“John’s a really good young player and a really good kid. I hope we can figure out a very fair and reasonable contract for him. I know Travis is very focused on keeping John Collins with the Atlanta Hawks.”

Antony Ressler on Travis Schlenk, John Collins, Dec 16, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Travis Schlenk on Clint Capela, John Collins
item.description:
“The first half of the season, when you think about the roster we had, just all the injuries on top of the suspension (of John Collins) and the second half of the season, once we kind of got past the injuries, past the suspension and we made the trade for Clint (Capela), we never had the opportunity to see him,”

Travis Schlenk on Clint Capela, John Collins, Apr 14, 2020. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

item.title: Brad Stevens on John Collins
item.description:
Chris Forsberg:Brad Stevens on John Collins:

“He’s a difference-maker. I think he’s one of the best rollers in the league, if not the best.… Collins is a guy that takes them and puts them at a different level.”

Brad Stevens on John Collins, Jan 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @ChrisForsberg_.

item.title: Lloyd Pierce on John Collins
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:Lloyd Pierce on John Collins' mindset:

“Bothered. He's not with the guys. Probably for the first time not playing basketball. This is tough. This is a big blow for anyone.”

Lloyd Pierce on John Collins, Nov 5, 2019. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Lloyd Pierce on John Collins
item.description:
Chris Kirschner:Lloyd Pierce on John Collins' suspension:

“This is what I've been charged with as a head coach, and it's to help John and support John get through this, not as a player but a person. That's where I mind is and where my mind went when everything occurred this morning.”

Lloyd Pierce on John Collins, Nov 5, 2019. Source: Twitter @ChrisKirschner.

item.title: Jabari Parker on John Collins, Trae Young
item.description:
“Trae Young is someone who can not only score but distribute. John Collins is a very, very good player.“I know the expectations. I can fulfill my role accordingly. I’m young, but they’re younger. One thing I take pride in is I’ve now been every player — from the first to last guy on the team. And I’m grateful for those experiences.”

Jabari Parker on John Collins, Trae Young, Aug 3, 2019. Source: Chicago Tribune.

item.title: Antony Ressler on John Collins
item.description:
Keeping players like Collins in the fold is the key to success.

“A player like John Collins is not going to stay with a team if it’s a second-tier franchise,”

Antony Ressler on John Collins, Aug 18, 2018. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.
